text:
emma-fin: Heads-up — Orchard Services sent INV-55678 for managed infra support ($12,400). PDF lists PO 'ORCH-2024' but NetSuite shows ORCH-024 as active. Concur flags PO mismatch.

tyler-proc: Can you attach the vendor email/snippet? Was this PO created by procurement or by vendor-side?

emma-fin: Vendor email snippet:
```
From: accounts@orchard-services.com
Invoice: INV-55678
Amount: $12,400.00
PO: ORCH-2024
```
Original approver is 'Product Infra' owner (Sam W.) who moved teams and didn't set delegate.

zara-acct: If we don't fix, payment will be delayed. We can either create a retro PO that preserves vendor PO field or alias ORCH-2024 -> ORCH-024. Procurement preference?

tyler-proc: Preference is create retro PO ORCH-2024-RET so audits show vendor reference. We'll then create alias mapping to avoid future rejects. Need approver to sign off — Sam W is unresponsive.

eli-ops: I can route this to Claire in Product; she's acting for Sam this quarter. Claire, can you approve or delegate?

vendor-bot: Reminder: Invoice INV-55678 is due in 5 business days.

claire-prod: I'm on it — approving the invoice contingent on procurement creating ORCH-2024-RET and linking to INV-55678 in NetSuite. Please add accounting note 'approved by Claire for Orchard invoice; retro PO to be created.'

zara-acct: Approved in Concur. procurement, please confirm NetSuite link and ticket number.

tyler-proc: PO ORCH-2024-RET created and linked: netsuite://record/PO/998877. Ticket PR-4789 opened for alias mapping. Vendor asked to update future invoices to use ORCH-024; procurement will confirm with them.

emma-fin: Thanks everyone — marking this thread resolved. Will follow up if vendor escalates.
